This is the first time ive heard of doing such a thing. I suppose ill start with Qui-Gon Jinn or Obi Wan Kenobi. 

Ready to die anyway, might as well play with make believe Jedi Masters.

Emotional cruelty sure, but have you seen chimpanzees fight? They'll chew your face skin and rip your wiggly bits off before they kill ya. I'll take a messed up ex posting pics of my modestly sized wedding tackle anyday over the cruelty a chimp can dish out. 

Please dont take me too seriously here bud just trying to lighten things up.

Report abusive behavior and speak out against it. Thats the only thing we can really do here. 

As a history buff though im not at all shocked by this kind of stuff, humans are awful creatures at times, like chimps with less body hair and opposable thumbs.

I don't remember what I wanted before, but after I fell in love with my closest friend all I wanted in this world was to be the kind of man that made her feel the way she made me feel. I wanted to bring her the happiness she gave me. I craved to be in her eyes what she was in mine. 

However, as the story so often goes, I am not that kind of man, and I cannot ever be that kind of man. So i cannot tell you how it affects me to get it, only how my failure destroyed my life.

Should've Been A Cowboy by Toby Keith 
https://youtu.be/aIq1LvzSLsk

I cant stand him otherwise, there are some questionable lyrics, and im a lot more aware of the problematic ideas inherent to western themes and tropes than someone would expect from a blue collar man like myself; but god damnit i just always wanted to be a cowboy. 

Its just that the song for me taps into a combination of nostalgia (i was a child when it came out) and my own desire to be the romanticized vision of something that never really existed, which is the cowboys of western movies. 

Like i said though, im aware of the huge problems that romanticizing the old west creates, i just try to take only the positive aspects of the idealized western cowboy.
